title: Medical Billing & Coding
excerpt: Maximize reimbursements with meticulous claim prep and industry-standard coding. Clean claims, faster payments.
description: Our certified coding team prepares every claim against current CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS guidelines, payer edits, and specialty-specific rules. We reduce preventable rejections, accelerate first-pass acceptance, and keep documentation aligned with what payers actually reimburse.
features: Specialty-specific CPT and ICD-10 coding review
Charge capture audits and missing-code recovery
Daily submission windows with status tracking

title: Credentialing & Enrollment
excerpt: Rapid, compliant payer enrollment. We handle the paperwork so providers can focus on patients.
description: Credentialing delays quietly stall revenue. We manage CAQH, PECOS, Medicaid, and commercial enrollment end to end—applications, primary source verification, follow-ups, and re-credentialing calendars—so new providers and locations start billing sooner.
features: Group, location, and rendering provider setup

title: A/R Recovery
excerpt: Slash aged receivables with targeted follow-up, root-cause fixes, and airtight workflows.
description: Aged A/R is rarely a follow-up problem alone. We segment inventory by payer, age, and denial reason, work the recoverable dollars first, and close the process gaps that keep the same balances aging month after month.
features: Weekly A/R aging and cash-forecast reports

title: Eligibility Verification
excerpt: Stop rejections before they start with upfront benefits checks and real-time coverage validation.
description: Most denials are born at the front desk. We verify coverage, benefits, authorizations, and patient responsibility before the visit so claims leave clean and patients understand their share of cost.

title: Denial Management
excerpt: Find the “why,” fix the “how.” Analytics-driven appeals and resubmissions that recover revenue.
description: We treat denials as a diagnostic signal. Every rejection is categorized, appealed when warranted, and traced back to coding, enrollment, eligibility, or documentation so the same dollar is not lost twice.
features: Timely appeals with clinical support packets

title: Revenue Analytics
excerpt: Actionable dashboards and KPI tracking to spot leakage and surface optimization opportunities.
description: Leadership should not wait for a month-end spreadsheet. Our dashboards track clean claims, A/R days, net collection rate, denial mix, and specialty performance so decisions happen while the money is still recoverable.
features: Live KPI dashboards for owners and managers
Payer mix, specialty, and provider scorecards
Monthly performance reviews with next actions
Export-ready reporting for boards and CFOs
